lede: County commissioners will be interviewing candidates for the Board of Adjustment and Planning Commission Tuesday — positions that shape how development happens across the valley. Meanwhile, the fire district board meets Monday to discuss wildfire preparations and Station 3 construction, and the Lodging Tax Board checks in Thursday on how visitor dollars are flowing to local organizations.

notable.stake: New appointees will decide future development and land-use appeals
